name: ContractSafe
description_en:
ContractSafe manages a searchable agreement repository and contract dates, with higher packages adding approval and full lifecycle work. Its pricing is based on features and active contract volume, with unlimited users.

The main operational distinction is between retaining an agreement and keeping its cancellation or renewal action assigned. Its date-management documentation describes suggested AI dates that a user confirms or edits, reminders and recurring renewal tracking.
description_zh:
ContractSafe 管理可搜索协议库及合同日期，高阶套餐增加审批及完整生命周期功能。定价依据功能和活跃合同数量，用户不限量。

保存协议与持续分配取消或续约行动，是两项不同工作。日期管理文档介绍由用户确认或修改的 AI 建议日期、提醒及循环续约跟踪。

sections.title_en: Follow the notice deadline rather than only expiry
sections.title_zh: 跟踪通知截止日，而不只是到期日
sections.en: For a supplier renewal, verify the extracted dates, assign reminder recipients and set a lead time that permits a decision before cancellation closes. The date page describes reminders to people without logins and reassignment when roles change. It also documents automatic advancement of renewal dates and reminders. Test a changed term before relying on this recurring schedule.
sections.zh: 供应商续约时，应复核提取日期、指定提醒收件人，并设置足够提前量，确保取消窗口关闭前完成决策。日期页说明无需登录的人员也能收提醒，角色变化时可重新分配；续约日期及提醒还能自动滚动。依赖循环计划前，应测试条款变化后的行为。

sections.title_en: Buy approval and integration scope deliberately
sections.title_zh: 明确购买审批及集成范围
sections.en: Organize covers storage, search, extraction and reporting. Finalize adds Word integration, approvals and eSignature; Maximize adds templates, intake, lifecycle tracking and API scope. The website listing of Salesforce does not make it an entry-package entitlement. Prepare roles and one exception path before a demo.
sections.zh: Organize 涵盖存储、搜索、提取和报表；Finalize 增加 Word 集成、审批及签署；Maximize 增加模板、申请、生命周期跟踪和 API。网站列出 Salesforce，不表示入门版包含。演示前可准备角色及一条例外路径。

sections.title_en: Confirm contract volume, billing period and currency
sections.title_zh: 确认合同量、付款周期和币种
sections.en: The homepage advertises starts of US$450, US$660 and US$815 per month for Organize, Finalize and Maximize respectively. Pricing depends on active-contract volume and feature scope; the pricing page shows annual prepayment and monthly/yearly controls, and says transactions are processed in USD. These starting figures are not a verified quote for a chosen volume. A normalized payable price is left unknown.
sections.zh: 主页分别列出 Organize、Finalize、Maximize 每月起价 450、660、815 美元。价格取决于活跃合同量和功能；定价页显示年度预付及月付／年付选项，并说明交易以美元处理。这些起价不是某个指定合同量的已核实应付报价，因此不填统一月价。

sections.title_en: Validate reminders and access with real contract roles
sections.title_zh: 用真实合同角色核对提醒与访问
sections.en: This service is relevant to teams replacing scattered files and date spreadsheets. A single occasional signature may not justify full lifecycle configuration. Check extracted dates and who receives attachments, especially for external reminder recipients. No hosted-region commitment, self-hosted distribution, licence text, delivery guarantee or failure recovery was verified. The proposed checks were not run.
sections.zh: 希望替代分散文件和日期表格的团队可评估该服务；偶尔签一次合同可能无需完整生命周期配置。应核对提取日期和附件收件人，尤其涉及外部提醒时。未核实托管地区承诺、自托管发行版、许可正文、送达保证或故障恢复，也未执行上述检查。
